title: 义务教育教科书·英语（清华）四年级下册

sentences.cn: 地球是我们所有人的家园。
sentences.en: The Earth is home to all of us.
Let’s take care of the Earth.
The air in the countryside is clean.
A farmer grows crops on the grassland.

sentences.cn: 我住的城市又大又热闹。
sentences.en: My city is big and busy.
There is a crocodile in the river.

sentences.cn: 丛林里生活着很多昆虫。
sentences.en: Many insects live in the jungle.

sentences.cn: 鲸和鲨鱼生活在海洋里。
sentences.en: Whales and sharks live in the ocean.

sentences.cn: 你知道工人做什么工作吗？
sentences.en: Do you know what a worker does?

sentences.cn: 有些动物，例如老虎，就生活在丛林里。
sentences.en: Some animals, for example tigers, live in the jungle.
Go straight down this street.

sentences.cn: 在第二个拐角处向左转。
sentences.en: Turn left at the second corner.
The bank is on the right side.
The bookstore is beside the library.
Take the subway to the cinema.
There is a supermarket near my home.

sentences.cn: 走两百米，然后你就会看到厕所。
sentences.en: Walk two hundred meters, then you will see the toilet.
The park is not far from here.
I will give him back the book.
Come back to the supermarket with me.
What can I do?
I find I’m in my bed.

sentences.cn: 我想当宇航员，飞到月球上去。
sentences.en: I want to be an astronaut and fly to the moon.

sentences.cn: 警察在街上抓住了一个贼。
sentences.en: The policeman catches a thief in the street.

sentences.cn: 医生在医院工作，给我打了一针。
sentences.en: The doctor works in the hospital and gives me a shot.

sentences.cn: 把药吃了，再量一下体温。
sentences.en: Take the medicine and check your temperature.
Mr Li teaches math and P.E.
What do you want to be when you grow up?

sentences.cn: 我今天感觉很好，我们玩一玩吧。
sentences.en: I feel well today, so let’s have some fun.
I like art and math.
A policeman directs the traffic and saves people.

sentences.cn: 这份工作充满危险，但我还是喜欢。
sentences.en: This job is full of danger, but I still like it.

sentences.cn: 我举起手，跟着自己的心走。
sentences.en: I raise my hand and follow my heart.
Put on your uniform and come with me.
My name is Autumn.
My name is Winter.
My name is Spring.
My name is Summer.
My name is Year.

sentences.cn: 你们的国庆节是什么时候？
sentences.en: When is your National Day?
It is April.
It is July.
It is October.
It is December.

sentences.cn: 一月、二月和三月是一年的头几个月。
sentences.en: January, February and March are the first months of the year.

sentences.cn: 六月、七月和八月是夏天的月份。
sentences.en: June, July and August are summer months.

sentences.cn: 九月、十月和十一月是秋天的月份。
sentences.en: September, October and November are autumn months.

sentences.cn: 五月是我最喜欢的月份。
sentences.en: May is my best month.

sentences.cn: 南瓜是由一颗小种子长成的。
sentences.en: A pumpkin grows from a small seed.
The king has a son.

sentences.cn: 我们把南瓜存放在冷屋子里。
sentences.en: We store the pumpkins in a cold room.
Put on your sweater before you go out.

sentences.cn: 五月六日和五月十日是我最喜欢的日子。
sentences.en: The sixth and the tenth of May are my favourite days.

sentences.cn: 年初的时候，我想成为一个更好的学生。
sentences.en: At the beginning of the year, I want to become a better student.

sentences.cn: 那家店在银行和学校之间。
sentences.en: The shop is between the bank and the school.
